en.title: Foot reflexology in Barcelona · Signature Healing Touch
en.description: Foot reflexology and massage in Barcelona by Riccardo Francescut. In your hotel, at home or in the studio. Executive Detox from €45. Ask for availability on WhatsApp.
en.lede: Foot reflexology in Barcelona: a gentle charge from the reflex points of your feet that rebalances the whole body. In your hotel, at home or in the studio.
en.avail: Mornings, afternoons and evenings. Ask for availability.
situations: Your feet carried you through the whole party. Forty-five minutes on the reflex points of your feet release the tired muscles and bring you back.
Twelve hours on your feet, then the city wakes up while you go to bed. A short, deep reset first helps the body let go of the night.
Gothic Quarter, Sagrada Família, the beach and back. Give your feet back what Barcelona took from them.
Forty-five minutes in the middle of the day: the body lets go, the head clears, and you go back in with your focus.
en.offers: Pay in cash −20% · in crypto −40% (BTC or ADA)

detox.text: One answer for every kind of tired. Muscular release on feet and legs, then a short detox sequence on the reflex points of the feet: “The 3 Ways of Purification”. You walk out lighter, with your focus back.

athlete.lead: Runs, matches, long sessions at the gym: your legs keep the score.
athlete.text: Decontracting work on calves and quadriceps, then precise reflexology on the points most connected to your sport. Only offered as a complete protocol.

balance.lead: When the head never stops and the body stays on alert, the feet are the quietest way back to calm.
balance.text: For stress and anxiety. Conscious pressure on the main reflex zones calms the nervous system and brings you back to your natural balance.

signature.lead: A long-standing discomfort deserves time and attention. We look at it together, then work on it.
signature.text: We start with a short personal anamnesis. Then “The 3 Ways of Purification” and a deep, specific phase on the reflex points linked to your issue.

purebody.text: A refined full body massage: continuous, flowing, enveloping touch, with no reflexology and no added ritual. The essence of my signature touch.

ritual.text: Two hours uniting full-body massage and deep foot reflexology. A slow-motion escape to release tension, quiet the mind and restore inner balance.

en.stepup_note: Only for the 45-minute Executive Detox. The discount is applied in person.
en.packs_lead: Four sessions for the price of three. Flexible booking with a unique voucher code, valid 1 year from purchase.
packs: Deeper work on chronic discomfort and long-term well-being.
A deep reset of the nervous system and ongoing balance.
Regular stress relief, muscle recovery and a steady wellness routine.
en.reviews_lead: Real reviews from clients since 2020, in their own language.
en.about_role: Cognitive Psychologist | Yoga Master | Reflexologist & Masseur
en.about_p1: A degree in Cognitive Psychology and a curiosity for how people think and act. Inspired by martial arts and Eastern healing traditions, since 2020 I dedicate myself to foot reflexology, Qi Gong, Yoga and subtle energy work.
en.about_p2: Yoga teacher, practitioner of Tai Chi, Qi Gong, Pa Kua Chang, breathwork and meditation. Certified reflexologist, ISMET (Instituto Superior de Medicinas Tradicionales).
en.about_langs: I speak Italiano · Español · English · Français
gallery: Yoga teacher, Tai Chi, Qi Gong and Pa Kua Chang practitioner
Precise work on the reflex points of the feet
Gentle, non-invasive and adapted to you
faq: In your hotel or at your home within Barcelona city, with a travel supplement of only €6, or in the studio at SLK Alkalina, Carrer de Sardenya 371. Tell me where you are on WhatsApp and we find the best option.
Book online from each treatment, or write to me on WhatsApp. Sessions are possible in the morning, afternoon and evening: always ask for availability to confirm your slot.
By card when you book online, or in person. On single sessions, paying in cash saves 20% and paying in crypto (BTC or ADA) saves 40%.
How does the Step-Up Challenge work?

Show a dated screenshot from your fitness app with your step total for any 24 hours within the 10 days before the appointment. 10,000+ steps: €40, 20,000+: €35, 30,000+: €30. Valid only for the 45-minute Executive Detox.
en.contact_lead: Write to me with the treatment you would like and where you are. I answer as soon as I can.
en.quote: “The feet are the mirror of the body. Through the feet, we can reach the whole.” — Eunice Ingham

es.title: Reflexología podal en Barcelona · Signature Healing Touch
es.description: Reflexología podal y masajes en Barcelona con Riccardo Francescut. En tu hotel, en casa o en el estudio. Executive Detox desde 45 €. Consulta disponibilidad por WhatsApp.
es.lede: Reflexología podal en Barcelona: una carga suave desde los puntos reflejos de tus pies que reequilibra todo el cuerpo. En tu hotel, en casa o en el estudio.
es.avail: Mañanas, tardes y noches. Consulta disponibilidad.
situations: Tus pies te llevaron durante toda la fiesta. Cuarenta y cinco minutos sobre los puntos reflejos de tus pies sueltan los músculos cansados y te devuelven a ti.
Doce horas de pie y luego la ciudad despierta mientras tú te vas a dormir. Un reset breve y profundo ayuda al cuerpo a soltar la noche.
Barrio Gótico, Sagrada Família, la playa y vuelta. Devuelve a tus pies lo que Barcelona les ha quitado.
Cuarenta y cinco minutos a mitad del día: el cuerpo se suelta, la cabeza se aclara y vuelves con toda tu concentración.
es.offers: Pago en efectivo −20% · en cripto −40% (BTC o ADA)

detox.text: Una respuesta para cada tipo de cansancio. Descarga muscular en pies y piernas y luego una breve secuencia detox en los puntos reflejos: “Las 3 Vías de Purificación”. Sales más ligero y con la mente despejada.

athlete.lead: Carreras, partidos, largas sesiones de gimnasio: tus piernas llevan la cuenta.
athlete.text: Trabajo descontracturante en gemelos y cuádriceps y luego reflexología precisa en los puntos más ligados a tu deporte. Solo como protocolo completo.

balance.lead: Cuando la cabeza no para y el cuerpo sigue en alerta, los pies son el camino más tranquilo hacia la calma.
balance.text: Para el estrés y la ansiedad. Una presión consciente sobre las principales zonas reflejas calma el sistema nervioso y te devuelve a tu equilibrio natural.

signature.lead: Una molestia de largo tiempo merece tiempo y atención. La miramos juntos y luego trabajamos sobre ella.
signature.text: Empezamos con una breve anamnesis personal. Luego “Las 3 Vías de Purificación” y una fase profunda y específica en los puntos reflejos ligados a tu molestia.

purebody.text: Un masaje de cuerpo completo refinado: un toque continuo, fluido y envolvente, sin reflexología ni ritual añadido. La esencia de mi toque.

ritual.text: Dos horas que unen masaje de cuerpo completo y reflexología podal profunda. Una escapada a cámara lenta para soltar tensiones, calmar la mente y recuperar el equilibrio.
